response.message: Astra: Your latest summary turned proposed operations into a verified match without an execution receipt; that conclusion remains unsupported. Stay with this addition test rather than expanding it yet. Look more closely at your choice to make left and right identical: what input-routing mistakes could that comparison fail to distinguish? Choose a small discriminating inspection and explain what it could establish before execution, versus what would still require an actual run.
response.rationale: Interrupts unsupported verification claims and redirects attention from harness expansion to the diagnostic value of the child's chosen inputs.
